auto_crisis.name: 2008 crash (deepest in the data)
auto_crisis.story: US housing loans went bad, Lehman Brothers collapsed and banks everywhere stopped lending to each other. Foreign investors pulled money out of India, and the Nifty 50 lost more than half its value in ten months. (Picked automatically: the deepest fall in our data.)
auto_crisis.label: 2008 crash (deepest in the data) · Dec 2007 – Dec 2008 · Nifty −60% · overlaps Global Financial Crisis (2008–09)

auto_calm.name: 2017–18 calm (calmest year in the data)
auto_calm.story: With steady domestic investor inflows into mutual funds and little global turmoil, the Nifty 50 climbed almost every month. India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', sat near record lows. (Picked automatically: the calmest year in our data.)
auto_calm.label: 2017–18 calm (calmest year in the data) · Jan 2017 – Feb 2018 · Nifty +28% · overlaps Demonetisation (2016), Low-volatility rally (2017)

gfc_2008.name: Global Financial Crisis (2008–09)
gfc_2008.story: US housing loans went bad, Lehman Brothers collapsed and banks everywhere stopped lending to each other. Foreign investors pulled money out of India, and the Nifty 50 lost more than half its value in ten months.
gfc_2008.label: Global Financial Crisis (2008–09) · Dec 2007 – Dec 2008 · Nifty −60% · overlaps 2008 crash (deepest in the data)
gfc_2008.support: Nifty 50 fell 59.9% peak to trough inside the search range

euro_2011.name: European debt crisis and US credit downgrade (2011)
euro_2011.story: Greece, Italy and Spain struggled to repay their debts while S&P cut the US credit rating for the first time ever. Indian stocks also faced high inflation and rising interest rates at home, so foreign money left.
euro_2011.label: European debt crisis and US credit downgrade (2011) · Oct 2010 – Oct 2011 · Nifty −28%
euro_2011.support: Nifty 50 fell 27.9% peak to trough inside the search range

taper_2013.name: Taper tantrum and rupee crash (2013)
taper_2013.story: The US Federal Reserve hinted it would slow its bond buying, and money rushed out of emerging markets. The rupee fell to a record low and Indian banks and importers were hit hard.
taper_2013.label: Taper tantrum and rupee crash (2013) · Apr 2013 – Apr 2014 · Nifty −15% · overlaps Post-election steady market (2014)
taper_2013.support: Nifty 50 fell 14.6% peak to trough inside the search range

china_2015.name: China devaluation and global sell-off (2015–16)
china_2015.story: China surprised markets by devaluing the yuan while its stock market and oil prices crashed. Fears of a global slowdown dragged Indian stocks down for almost a year.
china_2015.label: China devaluation and global sell-off (2015–16) · Jan 2015 – Feb 2016 · Nifty −23%
china_2015.support: Nifty 50 fell 22.5% peak to trough inside the search range

demon_2016.name: Demonetisation (2016)
demon_2016.story: On 8 November 2016 the government withdrew ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes, about 86% of the cash in circulation. Consumer spending froze for weeks, and the US election result the same night added global jitters.
demon_2016.label: Demonetisation (2016) · Sep 2016 – Oct 2017 · Nifty −8% · overlaps 2017–18 calm (calmest year in the data), Low-volatility rally (2017)
demon_2016.support: Nifty 50 fell 8.3% peak to trough inside the search range

ilfs_2018.name: IL&FS default and NBFC crisis (2018)
ilfs_2018.story: Infrastructure lender IL&FS defaulted on its debt, and investors stopped trusting non-bank lenders (NBFCs). Finance stocks crashed while oil prices and a weak rupee added pressure.
ilfs_2018.label: IL&FS default and NBFC crisis (2018) · Jul 2018 – Aug 2019 · Nifty −15%
ilfs_2018.support: Nifty 50 fell 14.6% peak to trough inside the search range

covid_2020.name: COVID-19 crash (2020)
covid_2020.story: The pandemic shut down economies and India announced a nationwide lockdown in March 2020. The Nifty 50 fell almost 40% in about two months, its fastest fall on record.
covid_2020.label: COVID-19 crash (2020) · Dec 2019 – Dec 2020 · Nifty −38%
covid_2020.support: Nifty 50 fell 38.4% peak to trough inside the search range

ukraine_2022.name: Russia–Ukraine war and rate hikes (2022)
ukraine_2022.story: Russia invaded Ukraine, oil and food prices jumped and central banks raised interest rates fast to fight inflation. Foreign investors sold Indian shares heavily for months.
ukraine_2022.label: Russia–Ukraine war and rate hikes (2022) · Sep 2021 – Sep 2022 · Nifty −17%
ukraine_2022.support: Nifty 50 fell 17.2% peak to trough inside the search range

adani_2023.name: Adani–Hindenburg sell-off (2023)
adani_2023.story: US short-seller Hindenburg Research accused the Adani Group of fraud, and Adani shares lost over $100 billion in value. The wider market wobbled on worries about bank exposure and global rate hikes.
adani_2023.label: Adani–Hindenburg sell-off (2023) · Dec 2022 – Dec 2023 · Nifty −7% · overlaps Low-VIX stretch (2023–24)
adani_2023.support: Nifty 50 fell 7.1% peak to trough inside the search range

fpi_2024.name: Foreign-investor sell-off correction (2024–25)
fpi_2024.story: After a record high in September 2024, foreign investors sold Indian shares at the fastest pace in years as earnings slowed and Chinese stocks looked cheaper. The Nifty 50 slid for five straight months.
fpi_2024.source: NSDL FPI Monitor, foreign portfolio investment net equity flows Oct 2024 – Feb 2025 (https://www.fpi.nsdl.co.in/)
fpi_2024.label: Foreign-investor sell-off correction (2024–25) · Aug 2024 – Sep 2025 · Nifty −16%
fpi_2024.support: Nifty 50 fell 15.8% peak to trough inside the search range

tariff_2025.name: US tariff shock (2025)
tariff_2025.story: The US announced sweeping 'Liberation Day' import tariffs on 2 April 2025 and markets worldwide sold off. Indian stocks fell sharply for a few days before recovering.
tariff_2025.label: US tariff shock (2025) · not available

tariff_2025.support: Nifty 50 fell 6.4% peak to trough inside the search range

calm_2017.name: Low-volatility rally (2017)
calm_2017.story: With steady domestic investor inflows into mutual funds and little global turmoil, the Nifty 50 climbed almost every month. India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', sat near record lows.
calm_2017.label: Low-volatility rally (2017) · Jan 2017 – Feb 2018 · Nifty +28% · overlaps 2017–18 calm (calmest year in the data), Demonetisation (2016)
calm_2017.support: lowest 126-day Nifty 50 volatility in the range 7.8% vs full-sample median 15.4%

calm_2014.name: Post-election steady market (2014)
calm_2014.story: A single-party majority in the May 2014 general election raised hopes of stable reforms. Falling oil prices helped India, and the market rose steadily with few sharp swings.
calm_2014.label: Post-election steady market (2014) · Dec 2013 – Dec 2014 · Nifty +32% · overlaps Taper tantrum and rupee crash (2013)
calm_2014.support: lowest 126-day Nifty 50 volatility in the range 12.3% vs full-sample median 15.4%

calm_2023.name: Low-VIX stretch (2023–24)
calm_2023.story: Strong economic growth and record inflows from domestic retail investors kept the market climbing calmly. India VIX touched multi-year lows for much of the year.
calm_2023.label: Low-VIX stretch (2023–24) · Nov 2022 – Dec 2023 · Nifty +9% · overlaps Adani–Hindenburg sell-off (2023)
calm_2023.support: lowest 126-day Nifty 50 volatility in the range 8.1% vs full-sample median 15.4%
